question:
A seating arrangement query: All are facing East. Q is seated third to the left of P.

Who is sitting immediately to the right of Q?

options.text: The person seated second to the left of P
The person seated two places to the right of P

solution:
A seating arrangement query:

 
• All are facing East.
 
• Q is seated third to the left of P.

The Final Arrangement is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/267b11f10a6542e9500358d9f525364b396219e637422c4a31a4d2299787a3da.png] 

So, the person seated second to the left of P is sitting immediately to the right of Q

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**
